Match plant names with other string distances (deprecated)

Source: R/match-fuzzyjoin.R
WFO.match.fuzzyjoin.Rd

Deprecated: use WFO.match(). On a test of 100 misspelled names against the WFO Plant List 2026-06, WFO.match.fuzzyjoin() took 2.7 times longer than WFO.match() and matched fewer names with a truncated genus correctly (33 against 38 of 40); it has none of the matching steps added in WorldFloraFast (Fuzzy.genus, Fuzzy.transfer, Fuzzy.one.strict, Fuzzy.epithet.check). It will be removed in a later version.

Usage

WFO.match.fuzzyjoin(
  spec.data = NULL,
  WFO.file = NULL,
  WFO.data = NULL,
  no.dates = TRUE,
  spec.name = "spec.name",
  Authorship = "Authorship",
  stringdist.method = "lv",
  fuzzydist.max = 4,
  Fuzzy.min = TRUE,
  acceptedNameUsageID.match = TRUE,
  squish = TRUE,
  spec.name.tolower = FALSE,
  spec.name.nonumber = TRUE,
  spec.name.nobrackets = TRUE,
  spec.name.sub = TRUE,
  sub.pattern = c(" sp[.] A", " sp[.] B", " sp[.] C", " sp[.]", " spp[.]", " pl[.]",
    " indet[.]", " ind[.]", " gen[.]", " g[.]", " fam[.]", " nov[.]", " prox[.]",
    " cf[.]", " aff[.]", " s[.]s[.]", " s[.]l[.]", " p[.]p[.]", " p[.] p[.]", "[?]",
    " inc[.]", " stet[.]", "Ca[.]", "nom[.] cons[.]", "nom[.] dub[.]", " nom[.] err[.]",
    " nom[.] illeg[.]", " nom[.] inval[.]", " nom[.] nov[.]", " nom[.] nud[.]",
    " nom[.] obl[.]", " nom[.] prot[.]", " nom[.] rej[.]", " nom[.] supp[.]",
    " sensu auct[.]"),
  cores = 1
)

Arguments

spec.data

A data.frame with the names to match, or a character vector (or factor) of names, which becomes column spec.name.

WFO.file

Path to the backbone file (classification.csv), read with WFO.read(). Ignored if WFO.data is given. If both are NULL, the backbone at the location remembered by WFO.remember() or WFO.download() is read.

WFO.data

The backbone as a data.frame or data.table (from WFO.read(), WFO.remember() or WFO.backbone()).

no.dates

Deprecated and ignored (columns created and modified of the backbone are always left out of the results); giving it produces a warning.

spec.name

Name of the column with full plant names (without authors). If this column is absent, names are matched via Genus, Species, Infraspecific.rank and Infraspecific.

Authorship

Name of the column with the naming authors. If present, column Auth.dist gives the Levenshtein distance between the submitted and matched authors. As in WorldFlora, an empty author ("") gives the number of characters of the matched authors; use NA for unknown authors (distance Inf).

stringdist.method

Distance method of stringdist::stringdist(), such as "lv" (Levenshtein), "osa", "dl", "jw" or "qgram".

fuzzydist.max

Maximum distance of fuzzy matches.

Fuzzy.min

If TRUE, keep only the fuzzy matches with the smallest distance.

acceptedNameUsageID.match

If TRUE, replace matched synonyms by their accepted names (via acceptedNameUsageID), keeping the synonym in columns Old.*.

squish

If TRUE, remove repeated white space and white space at the start and end of names (as stringr::str_squish()).

spec.name.tolower

If TRUE, convert names to lower case, with a capital first letter.

spec.name.nonumber

If TRUE, names that contain numbers are interpreted as genera (only the first word is kept, without trailing digits).

spec.name.nobrackets

If TRUE, remove the part of names from the first "(" onwards (such as authors in brackets).

spec.name.sub

If TRUE, delete sections of names that match sub.pattern.

sub.pattern

Regular expressions of sections to delete, such as " sp[.]", " cf[.]" or " nom[.] illeg[.]".

cores

Number of cores for fuzzy matching (parallel::mclapply(); not on Windows).

Value

As WFO.match(), without columns Fuzzy.toomany, Fuzzy.two, Fuzzy.one and First.dist. Fuzzy.dist is the distance of stringdist.method. Candidates are numbered 1, 2, ... in Subseq (WorldFlora kept the numbers from before Fuzzy.min).

Details

An alternative to WFO.match() that finds fuzzy matches by a string distance of package stringdist (Levenshtein by default) within a maximum distance, rather than by agrep(). In WorldFlora this function used fuzzyjoin::stringdist_left_join(); WorldFloraFast computes the same matches with stringdist::stringdist() directly.

Names are cleaned as in WFO.match(). Names without an exact match are compared with all backbone names, once per distinct name; for the edit distances "lv", "osa", "dl" and "hamming", names whose number of characters differs by more than fuzzydist.max are skipped, which does not change the results. Requires the stringdist package.

See also

WFO.match(), WFO.one()

Examples

data(WFO.example2026)
m <- suppressWarnings(WFO.match.fuzzyjoin(
  c("Faidherbia albida", "Omalanthus populneus", "Pygeum africanum"),
  WFO.data = WFO.example2026
))
#> Checking for fuzzy matches for 1 records
#> 
#> Checking new accepted IDs
m[, c("spec.name", "Fuzzy.dist", "scientificName")]
#>              spec.name Fuzzy.dist        scientificName
#> 1    Faidherbia albida         NA     Faidherbia albida
#> 2 Omalanthus populneus          2 Homalanthus populneus
#> 3 Omalanthus populneus          2 Homalanthus populneus
#> 4     Pygeum africanum         NA       Prunus africana
